'''Kaqemeex''' (pronounced "cake mix") is a [[Guthix]]ian [[druid]] who can be found in the [[Druid's circle]] in [[Taverley]].

Kaqemeex is the start point of the quest [[Druidic Ritual]], the quest required to start learning the skill of [[Herblore]]. During the quest, players learn that he is the master for Herblore. Players with level 99 in Herblore may buy the [[Herblore cape]] from him for 99,000 [[coins]].

==Stock==
Note: If a player has multiple [[Skill mastery|99s]], they will receive the trimmed variant of the cape instead.

==Trivia==
*Kaqemeex was the main NPC during the [[2014 Midsummer event|2014]] and [[2015 Midsummer event]], where players would solve Riddles given to them by [[Thordur]], for rewards such as the [[half full wine jug]] and the untradeable [[druidic wreath]]. Players could also keep the [[disk of returning]] given to them by Thordur.
